title: SPIELräume. Gestaltungsfelder der Erwachsenenbildung zwischen Freiheit und Restriktion
summary: Where are the areas of freedom in adult and continuing education? How are these areas shaped at the individual, institutional or societal level? What factors restrict them? This volume explores ‘scopes for action’ in two senses: generally, in terms of opportunities for shaping educational practice, its history, theory and critical reflection; and specifically, in relation to play and the act of playing within the context of learning and education in adulthood.
